The start was a fast one and as the stream of runners became strung out down the long straight towards the village on the first lap of the 'top', John Bicourt and second-claimer Mike Kortenray immediately broke away.
Competing for other clubs we find Mike Kortenray 337th and, knowing of his performances at Fell Running, it was no surprise to see the name of John Blair Fish 512th.
This time it was Mike Kortenray one of our most enthusiastic and determined second claim members who took the honours with the second fastest time of the day.
Another fine victory for Alan McIntosh with a very good time in extremely cold conditions, although Mike Kortenray and Laurie O'Hara gave him a run for his money in the early stages.
There is little doubt that had they followed 2nd claim winner Mike Kortenray the result would not have been altered, but both Laurie and Andy would have been credited with better times.
